tools.name: search_shoe_models
tools.description: Search the Shoe Fit database for shoe brands and models by keyword, brand slug, or gender. Always use this tool first to resolve natural language shoe names (like 'Nike Pegasus 40' or 'Adidas Samba') into canonical `modelSlug` and `brandSlug` identifiers.

tools.name: recommend_shoe_size
tools.description: Calculate the exact recommended shoe size (EU, US, UK) for a target shoe model (`toModelSlug`) using millimeter cavity measurements and real-world fit offsets. Supports recommending from a reference shoe the user owns (`fromModelSlug` + `fromSize`) or from a direct foot measurement (`footLengthMm`).

tools.name: compare_shoe_models
tools.description: Compare sizing, millimeter internal length/width offsets, community fit statistics, and full size-by-size conversion tables between two shoe models (`modelSlugA` and `modelSlugB`).

tools.name: get_brand_size_chart
tools.description: Retrieve the official EU / US / UK / millimeter foot-length size chart for a shoe brand (e.g. 'nike', 'adidas', 'hoka', 'birkenstock'), or list all supported brands if `brandSlug` is omitted.
